changes: Sign in from the chat: when Claude Code is not signed in, a Sign in button opens its sign-in page instead of "Please run /login".
Install Claude Code: when it is not found, runs Anthropic's installer and then its sign-in. Copy details copies where Vellum Plot looked, for a report.
Text size: Aa beside Change makes the Assistant's text larger or smaller, and is remembered.
Buttons line up at any text size, and Sign in and Done respond to hover, press and the keyboard.
From 0.3.0: fits stay connected to their data, with Update, Keep updated and Change parameters.
Coming from Patina Plot 0.1.x: it is now Vellum Plot (0.2.0), with the Assistant; your projects, settings and templates come along.
